rules: Work on features in order unless a later one is blocked only by an earlier one you already finished.
Only change the `passes` field. Never delete, reword, reorder, or merge features.
Set `passes` to true only after every step is verified by an automated test (Vitest or Playwright) that is committed and green.
If the spec and a feature disagree, the spec wins; record the conflict in open-questions.md instead of editing the feature.
docs/acceptance-tests.md is human-owned: never edit it. Implement each scenario as a Playwright test in e2e/acceptance/ that checks every expected outcome; never weaken or skip them.

features.description: Project scaffold: pnpm, Vite, React, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind.
steps: `pnpm install` succeeds on a clean checkout with Node 22
`pnpm dev` serves the app and the page renders without console errors
`pnpm build` produces a static `dist/`

features.description: Quality commands: lint, typecheck, unit tests.
steps: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` each run with one command and exit 0
`pnpm test` runs at least one Vitest test
`pnpm check` runs lint, typecheck, unit tests and build in sequence
`pnpm e2e` builds or starts the app and runs Playwright in headless Chromium
A smoke test opens the app and finds the Canvas/Document toggle
Each e2e test starts from an empty IndexedDB
`pnpm build && pnpm preview` serves a working app
The app needs no server-side code or environment variables

features.description: Design data model and empty-design factory with template keys.
steps: Types exist for Design (title, sections, layout, updatedAt) and Section (keyProperties, rationale, tradeoffs, diagram)

The empty design has exactly 9 sections in canonical order: Problem Space, Evaluation (Offline), Baseline, Validation, Data & Features, Evaluation (Online), Integration, Monitoring, Target Solution & Architecture
Each section has the template keys from the spec table with empty values; Validation has none
Unit tests cover the factory
A pure function returns true only when there are >=2 options, >=1 criterion, every cell is non-empty and exactly one option is chosen
Unit tests cover each failing condition separately and the passing case
A pure function returns true when the Excalidraw scene has at least one non-deleted element
Unit tests cover an empty scene, a scene with only deleted elements, and a scene with elements

features.description: Section emptiness rule used by the document and export.
steps: A pure function returns true when all key property values are empty, rationale is empty, the trade-off matrix has no options and the diagram is empty
Unit tests cover each part

features.description: Single Zustand store is the only source of truth for both modes.
steps: Actions exist for title, key properties, rationale, trade-offs, diagram and layout changes
Unit tests cover each action
Canvas and Document components read and write only through the store
Edit a key property value, reload the page: the value is still there
Draw on a whiteboard, reload: the drawing is still there
First visit with empty storage shows the empty design
A 'Load example' control exists
Clicking it asks for confirmation because it overwrites the current design
Cancel keeps the current design unchanged
Confirm loads the Churn Prediction (Telecom) example, which fills every section, has complete trade-offs in at least 3 sections and diagrams in at least 2
The example lives in one fixture file reused by e2e tests
Header shows the design title, the Canvas/Document toggle and export controls
No avatars, Share button or contributor count
Clicking the title turns it into an input; Enter saves, Escape cancels
An empty title is shown as 'Untitled design'
The title persists after reload

features.description: Nine section cards in the mockup's initial layout.
steps: All 9 cards render with icon and uppercase section name
Initial layout matches docs/mockups/canvas.png: three rows of cards, Target Solution & Architecture spanning full width at the bottom
Evaluation (Offline) is used instead of Evaluation Strategy
A card shows at most the first 4 key properties as key/value pairs
With more than 4, a '+N' counter shows the number of hidden ones
Empty values show a muted placeholder

features.description: Inline editing of key property values on the card.
steps: Clicking a value on a card turns it into an input
Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels
The new value appears in the Component Editor and the Document
A card whose diagram is non-empty shows an SVG thumbnail of it
A card with an empty diagram shows no thumbnail area
Editing the diagram updates the thumbnail after the editor closes
Each card footer shows a Details button and two indicators, Trade-offs and Diagram, which are not clickable
Each indicator has exactly two states: off and bright
Trade-offs is bright only when the completeness rule (model-02) holds
Diagram is bright only when the diagram is non-empty (model-03)
Cards can be dragged to new positions
The layout persists after reload
Dragging does not change section content
Cards can be resized from a corner handle within sensible min sizes
The new size persists after reload
A 'Reset layout' control restores the initial mockup layout
Section content is unchanged after reset
Details on a card opens a modal titled with the section name
The modal closes with the X button, Escape, and a click outside
A 'Saved' indicator reflects autosave state
The modal has four parts in order: Decisions & Properties, Rationale & Notes, Trade-off Matrix, Whiteboard
'+ Add Property' adds an empty key/value row
Keys and values are editable, including template keys
A row can be deleted
Changes appear on the card immediately
TipTap editor with bold, italic, inline code, bullet list, ordered list and link
Content persists after reload
The toolbar has an image button that is disabled and shows a 'Coming soon' tooltip
'Add Option (Row)' and 'Add Criteria (Col)' add a row and a column
Option names, criterion names and cells are editable
Rows and columns can be deleted
Exactly one option can be marked as chosen; marking another moves the mark
The chosen option is visually highlighted
The card's Trade-offs indicator updates live as the matrix changes
Choosing an option does not change key properties
The whiteboard is the @excalidraw/excalidraw React component, not an iframe
Drawing persists after reload
The card's Diagram indicator and thumbnail update
The toggle switches to Document mode and back without losing state
The document heading is the design title, with 'ML System Architecture Spec' as subtitle and a 'Last updated' line
Layout matches docs/mockups/document.png: document column and an 'On this page' table of contents on the right
Sections appear as numbered headings in canonical order
Reordering cards on the canvas does not change the document order
Each filled section shows a key properties plate, the rationale, the trade-off matrix as a table with the chosen option marked, and the diagram as an image
Parts that are empty inside a filled section are omitted
An empty section (model-04) shows its heading and a 'Not filled yet' placeholder
'On this page' lists all 9 sections
Clicking an entry scrolls to the section
The entry of the section in view is highlighted

features.description: Inline editing of key properties in the document.
steps: Clicking a value on the key properties plate makes it editable
After saving, the canvas card shows the new value

features.description: Inline editing of rationale in the document.
steps: The rationale is editable in place with the same TipTap editor
After editing, the Component Editor shows the same content

features.description: Inline editing of the trade-off matrix in the document.
steps: Cells, option names and the chosen mark are editable in place
Changes appear in the Component Editor and update the card indicator
An edit in Canvas mode is visible in Document mode right after switching, without reload
An edit in Document mode is visible in Canvas mode right after switching, without reload
Covered for key properties, rationale, trade-offs and diagram

A pure function turns a Design into Markdown: title, subtitle, numbered section headings, key properties table, rationale as Markdown, trade-off matrix as a table with the chosen option marked, diagram image links to images/<section-id>.svg
Empty sections are excluded
A snapshot test runs on the example fixture
With no non-empty diagrams, 'Export Markdown' downloads a single `<title-slug>.md`
The file content equals the generator output

features.description: Markdown download with diagrams as ZIP.
steps: With at least one non-empty diagram, 'Export Markdown' downloads `<title-slug>.zip`
The ZIP contains `<title-slug>.md` and `images/*.svg`, one per non-empty diagram
Every image link in the Markdown resolves to a file in the ZIP
'Export PDF' opens the browser print dialog for the document
Print styles show only the document: no header, toggle or table of contents
`page.pdf()` in Playwright produces a PDF that contains every filled section heading
If any section is empty, both exports first show a warning with the number of empty sections
The user can continue or cancel
With no empty sections there is no warning
Below 1280px viewport width the app shows an 'Open on desktop' screen instead of the editor
At 1280px and above the app works normally
An e2e test saves screenshots of the canvas, the Component Editor and the document with the example loaded to `e2e/screenshots/`
Each screenshot is compared by eye with the matching file in docs/mockups/ and differences are noted in open-questions.md
Each scenario AT-01..AT-14 has its own Playwright test in e2e/acceptance/ whose name starts with the scenario ID
Each test checks every 'Ожидаем' item of its scenario literally
No acceptance test is skipped or marked fixme
All acceptance tests pass
`pnpm check` and `pnpm e2e` (including e2e/acceptance/) pass on a clean checkout
No TODOs left for features marked as passing
